infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Cricchat uses the camera when you choose to take a photo or video inside a conversation to send to a contact, or to capture a new profile picture. For example, tap the camera icon in a chat to take and send a photo.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Cricchat uses the microphone when you record a voice message to send in a conversation, or during a voice or video call with a contact. For example, hold the microphone button in a chat to record and send a voice note.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Cricchat accesses your photo library only when you choose to attach an existing photo or video to send in a conversation, or to set your profile picture. For example, tap the attachment icon in a chat to pick a photo to send.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Cricchat to access your photos.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Cricchat to access your camera.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Cricchat to access your microphone for voice messages.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Cricchat to use your camera for calls.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Cricchat to use your microphone for calls.
